purpose: Freeze the shortest responsible engineering path from trader-fidelity proof to production eligibility. This roadmap is governance, not a source of trading thresholds and not a license to weaken evidence gates for speed.

FIDELITY.goal: Prove the algorithm translates the trader's actual key-zone, TP/first-reaction, candle-story, live-force and entry-clock decisions without hindsight.
required_work: complete exact-head FORCE1 mechanical replay/timing audit
compare trader and bot key zones geometrically
compare trader and bot TP/first-reaction zones geometrically
compare action, force state and exact entry clock
mine disagreements and repair only demonstrated strategy-fidelity defects
turn every accepted fidelity repair into permanent regression evidence
FIDELITY.exit_rule: No known material trader-vs-bot semantic disagreement remains unresolved and all exact-head fidelity/architecture tests are green.

FREEZE.goal: Stop strategy motion on one exact SHA before performance certification.
required_work: lock executable semantics and release identity
refresh architecture receipt on exact head
forbid post-freeze rule rescue from observed PnL
FREEZE.exit_rule: One exact immutable strategy SHA is designated for the clean edge exam.

CLEAN_EDGE.goal: Run the preregistered clean MNQ evidence exam without parameter search or best-variant selection.
CLEAN_EDGE.exit_rule: Pass all preregistered clean evidence gates or stop promotion.

ROBUSTNESS.goal: Try to break a passing clean edge without changing the strategy to rescue results.
priority_attacks: small parameter-neighborhood stability where allowed without clean-result selection
ROBUSTNESS.exit_rule: Edge remains positive under every required weakest-link attack.

EXECUTION.goal: Prove theoretical signals survive realistic order and broker mechanics.
EXECUTION.exit_rule: Execution defects cannot silently change certified signal semantics or create unreconciled risk.

SHADOW.goal: Run the exact certified engine beside the live market without real-money promotion.
SHADOW.exit_rule: Shadow campaign and operational evidence pass on the exact certified build.

PRODUCTION.goal: Allow production eligibility only after every upstream gate passes.
PRODUCTION.exit_rule: Production eligibility receipt exists for the intended exact build/account/device; PR merge remains a separate explicit decision.

parallel_lanes.A_STRATEGY_FIDELITY: Human-vs-Bot replay, disagreement mining, fidelity regression repairs.
parallel_lanes.B_INFRASTRUCTURE: Runtime/memory performance, CI speed, deterministic replay and data-loading reliability. Infrastructure work must not change strategy semantics silently.
parallel_lanes.C_EVIDENCE: Causality, fingerprints, receipts, data integrity, clean-exam readiness.
parallel_lanes.D_EXECUTION: Shadow/runtime parity and broker safety may be prepared in parallel but may not alter frozen trading semantics.

speed_rules: Prefer parallel independent lanes over serial waiting.
Diagnose -> fix -> commit -> rerun -> inspect -> repeat until green or a genuine external/tool/permission blocker.
Do not stop at an intermediate discovery when the repair can be completed safely in the same engineering chain.
Build only work that materially advances the current critical path or removes a real blocker.
Never trade correctness, causality, evidence integrity or safety for calendar speed.
hard_non_goals_until_v24_is_decided: widening the 17.25-point stop to rescue performance
moving TP farther because historical PnL looks better
using future candles or final parent OHLC to backdate an entry
substituting NQ or synthetic pre-launch MNQ for required clean MNQ evidence

frozen_strategy_invariants.master_equation: TRADE = SESSION AND PREMARKET_PRIOR AND VALID_KEY_LOCATION_OR_APPROVED_PREBREAK_EXCEPTION AND VALID_CANDLE_STORY AND SUSTAINED_INTRA_CANDLE_DIRECTIONAL_FORCE AND ROOM_TO_FIRST_REACTION AND FIRST_A_PLUS AND DAILY_BULLET_UNUSED

evidence_chronology.seen_development_data: 2022-01-01..2026-08-17 and Jan-Apr 2026 M26 are development/seen only; never promote or tune from their PnL.
evidence_chronology.prior_clean_attempt_rule: Preserve the aborted seal evidence. It produced no ledger/report/folds/edge result and may not be described as a completed edge exam.
evidence_chronology.semantic_change_rule: Any material trading-semantic change invalidates prior evidence for promotion and requires a new exact-head evidence chain.
